services.value: Specialty Analytical provides environmental and analytical laboratory testing services including metals testing (e.g., ICP-MS and mercury methods), organics testing (e.g., VOC methods such as EPA 8260), conventional chemistry testing (e.g., TOC, sulfate, turbidity), and inorganic/environmental regulatory program support (e.g., CWA, RCRA, UST, RBCA, CERCLA). The website also lists courier services and in-house testing capabilities.
